name: Yves
source:
[i]"Even if no one ends up loving me, I'll still love everyone no matter what."[/i]

[i]Embracing his fate to love[/i]

A member of the Corps who also runs a handyman business called Courrune. He is well-known in Coene, and highly trusted for his earnest and sincere nature. His innate benevolence allows him to forgive even those who have committed evil deeds. He was disowned by his parents after an accident that caused his face to become scarred from burns. He believes that, as long as he continues to love and help others, he will someday meet a person who will love him in return.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Courrune handyman, Corps member

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
